camel_example: aliyun iot CreateSharePromotionSpeechModel --region cn-hangzhou --ShareTaskCode 52000000_700e_4003_900e_610000000000 --SharePromotionActivityId 61000000_0000_4901_0000_4700000000000 --SpeechModelType custom --Text test --AudioFormat wav --Voice Xiaoyun --BizCode ZFDZ
description_en: Creates shared speech models for promotional activities of voice broadcast sharing tasks
description_zh: 调用该接口为千里传音分享任务的促销活动创建共享语料
kebab_example: aliyun iot create-share-promotion-speech-model --voice Xiaoyun --share-promotion-activity-id 61000000_0000_4901_0000_4700000000000 --speech-model-type custom --biz-code ZFDZ --audio-format wav --share-task-code 52000000_700e_4003_900e_610000000000 --text test --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSharePromotionSpeechModel

parameters.help_en: The voice used to broadcast the speech model. The voice is preset by the system, such as standard female voice and standard male voice. You can query the available voice types by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/217887.html operation and specify the Value from the VoiceList response parameter
parameters.help_zh: 语料播报声音，由系统预设，例如标准女声、标准男声等。可以选择的声音类型通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/217887.html进行查询，填入返回参数中**VoiceList**中**Value**的值
parameters.name: voice

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the promotional activity.

Set the value to the Data value returned by the CreateSharePromotionActivity operation
parameters.help_zh:
促销活动ID。

调用接口CreateSharePromotionActivity返回的Data值
parameters.name: share_promotion_activity_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the speech model. Only the fixed value custom is supported, which indicates a custom speech model
parameters.help_zh: 语料类型，仅支持取值目前只支持固定值custom，表示自定义语料
parameters.name: speech_model_type

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the instance. You can view instance ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview tab in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If the instance has an ID, you must specify the ID. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the instance does not have an ID, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页签，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The identifier of the speech model. The identifier is user-defined, supports letters and digits, and must be 1 to 32 characters in length. It must be unique within the project.

We recommend that you use an abbreviation of the speech model semantics as the identifier. For example, set the identifier to `PR` for `Payment received`
parameters.help_zh:
语料标识，由用户自定义，支持英文字母和数字，长度为1~32个字符，项目下保证唯一。

建议将语料语义的拼音首字母设置为语料标识，例如：`支付到账`设置为`ZFDZ`
parameters.name: biz_code

parameters.help_en: The broadcast speed. Valid values: -500 to 500
parameters.name: speech_rate

parameters.help_en: The audio format. Only the wav and mp3 formats are supported
parameters.name: audio_format

parameters.help_en:
The sharing code of the sharing task.

For more information about the sharing code of a sharing task, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607661.html
parameters.help_zh:
分享任务的分享码。

分享任务的分享码信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607661.html
parameters.name: share_task_code

parameters.help_en: The text of the speech model. The text supports letters, Chinese characters, and spaces, and must be 1 to 100 characters in length. Each Chinese character counts as two characters
parameters.help_zh: 语料文本，支持英文字母、汉字和空格，长度为1~100个字符，一个汉字占两个字符
parameters.name: text

Code.description_en:
The status code returned.
If the call is successful, an empty value is returned.
If the call fails, an error code is returned. For more information, see the Error codes section below
Code.description_zh:
调用结果状态码：
调用成功，返回空值。
调用失败，返回错误码。详细信息，请参见下文错误码

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
